decisions.packFormat: Standard hobby configuration: 12 cards per pack, 36 packs per box.
decisions.series: One VCS product combines two equal 264-card base series.
decisions.gold: One guaranteed Gold in VCS. The VCS rip engine supports one hit per ProductSet per pack. Physical bonus Gold (1:4) and jumbo collation are documented separately.
decisions.rookies: 24 TCDB-indexed true rookie labels appear on Base only. Super Rookies is a separate subset.
decisions.unknownOdds: Finest and two original redemption families are staged without pack odds.
decisions.excludedIssues: Pre-production samples, the promo sheet, Certified Winner replacements and the separate O-Pee-Chee product are outside this draft.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Two 264-card series in one base checklist.

productSets.name: Gold
productSets.notes: One Gold slot per VCS pack. Physical standard packs sometimes had a second Gold.

productSets.name: Black Gold
productSets.notes: Numbered player cards across both series.

productSets.name: Finest
productSets.notes: Shared Topps and O-Pee-Chee Series Two issue. Published insertion rate not verified.

productSets.name: Team USA
productSets.notes: Physical Topps Series Two rate 1:12. Combined equal-series VCS rate 1:24.

productSets.name: Black Gold Redemptions
productSets.notes: Original pack-issued exchange cards. Mail-in Certified Winners excluded.

productSets.name: Finest Redemptions
productSets.notes: Two unnumbered exchange cards. VCS identifiers distinguish their prizes.
